title: Workspace organization and evidence integrity
change: Established a project entry point and local Git history; classified tools, research evidence and publication archives; preserved original experiment paths and retired a redundant Site checkout.

checks.name: Migration targets and removed old paths
Frozen baselines, historical run batches, research datasets and source snapshots
Regenerable cache, previews and verified duplicate removed from workspace
checks.recovery: Windows Recycle Bin; no disk-space-reclaimed claim

checks.name: Maintained Python source parsing and migrated ROOT anchors
Current README navigation and static builder inputs
Lab import, UI paths, four harness source paths and frozen baseline
Historical research exports
checks.remaining_differences: Five display separators and export timestamp only; research numbers unchanged.

checks.name: Studies and tests record visible in local browser; three evidence downloads served and matched local JSON

limitations: Filesystem integrity and build compatibility do not establish assistance quality.
No new research experiment, model call, real-ASR check or user study.
Proposal tooling received syntax and path checks; the PDF was not regenerated or visually revalidated.
Active services, their open logs and concurrently edited UI work were preserved in place.
Root Git is local; raw runs, downloaded datasets and independent repositories still require separate backups.

failures_and_resolution.problem: Experiment virtualenv cannot resolve America/Halifax because tzdata is absent.
failures_and_resolution.resolution: Used the existing system Python with tzdata; left the experiment environment unchanged.

failures_and_resolution.problem: First integrity checker treated a derived data directory named ROOT as the project root.
failures_and_resolution.resolution: Limited anchor checking to actual __file__ ancestor expressions, then reran the complete check.

failures_and_resolution.problem: Permanent batch deletion was blocked by automatic safety review.
failures_and_resolution.resolution: Used Windows Recycle Bin for reversible cleanup after checking exact paths and hashes.
